The WYSIWYG markdown editor draws and scrolls: RichMarkdownEditWidget shows a RichDocument the way the viewer does - run faces and link colour, strikethrough, inline-code and code-block shading, list markers and numbering, heading sizes, one continuous bar for a multi-paragraph quote, and tables as their grid with zebra stripes, a bold header and cell text - with the selection highlight (cell by cell in reading order inside a table) and a steady caret when focused, in a table cell too, and an EmptyHint on an empty, unfocused document. The caret's side of a wrap is kept beside the selection (CaretAtLineEnd, set through SetSelection) since the model's positions have none. Each block keeps its own layout (RichBlockLayout or RichTableLayout behind IRichBlockLayout): an edit re-lays out only the blocks it touched or the ordered items it renumbered, a width, DeviceScale or text-size change re-lays out everything, and only blocks in view are painted. A relayout keeps the content at the top of the view still, so typing in or above it never scrolls the page. Document can be replaced (SetDocument adopts an undo or redo result, clamping the selection into it), and Relayout(first, last) covers edits spanning blocks. Raw blocks show rendered as hosted viewer widgets at their block, rebuilt when the theme or scale changes; images load through the viewer's loader and re-lay out their block when they arrive. Mouse and keyboard come next.

The WYSIWYG markdown writer regenerates changed lists, quotes and alignment wrappers instead of throwing. A group still exactly as parsed writes its original bytes, decided for every group in one pass; a changed one is rebuilt whole from the model with a blank line to its neighbours. Lists indent each level to its parent's content column, take marker, numbering start and spacing from each sublist's first item, renumber from that start, and keep a loose list loose through a new per-sublist Loose flag read from Markdig (edits give new blocks blank-line gaps, so gaps cannot tell). A list written right after another of the same kind and marker switches bullet or delimiter so the two stay separate. Quotes prefix every line with "> " and join paragraphs with a ">" line; aligned paragraphs and headings get one <div align> per run, never two tags without a blank line between.
